name: Bahya Nireekshana
author: rajeevrama
description: Live upload/download speed in the bar, with a panel of daily, weekly and monthly usage per connection (vnstat), live per-app usage (nethogs), and OpenSnitch firewall status, blocklists and allowlist

barWidget.description: Live transfer speed with usage history and firewall status

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: Show download/upload speed only while something is transferring, all the time, or never. Right-click the widget to cycle.

schema.label: Interfaces counted
schema.description: Comma-separated interface names to total, e.g. wlan0,enp3s0. Empty counts Wi-Fi, Ethernet and mobile links; VPN tunnels are left out so traffic isn't counted twice.

schema.label: Warn when the firewall isn't asking
schema.description: Mark the widget when OpenSnitch is stopped or its prompt window isn't running.
